producer.name: codex normalization
producer.ingestedFrom: effort value and intent, or retract

transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Bootstrap reads reasoningEffort, else effort, and upserts intent observed. Root configured.effort upserts intent configured.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: thread/settings/updated retracts effort when the key is present and the value is not a non-empty string.
